quote: The agreement covers the engineering, procurement and construction of a 60 MWh / 30 MW Battery Energy Storage System … at a contract sum of US$27,366,171.06. … two 30 MWh / 15 MW lithium-ion battery systems will be installed at the New Sophia and Goedverwagting substations
